name: New York City Department of Environmental Protection (12 WRRF CSO permits)
receiving_waters: Jamaica Bay tributaries (Bergen, Thurston, Fresh Creek, Hendrix, Spring Creek, Paerdegat)
outfalls_source: https://data.ny.gov/d/ephi-ffu6 (NYC rows, 2015); NYC CSO outfall map PDF https://www.nyc.gov/assets/dep/downloads/pdf/water/stormwater/cso-outfalls-map.pdf; DEC 2025 report: 397 permitted outfalls at 12 WRRFs
notification_channel: Generic citywide NY-Alert per rain event (notifier 'NYCDEP City Wide CSO', id NYCDEPCSO: 'Wet weather-related combined sewer overflows may have occurred'); Waterbody Advisory System for 45 waterbodies (https://nycwaterbodyadvisory.azurewebsites.net/, JSON /api/advisory); Notify NYC waterbody alerts (https://a858-nycnotify.nyc.gov/notifynyc/)
notes: 2025 DEC report: 397 current outfalls; largest modeled single-outfall count 36 events; avg annual CSO volume 12,370 MG (ICN cites DEC: 20.25 billion gal in 2024). DEP's nyc.gov CSO page cites '700 combined sewer outfalls' (includes non-CSO). Rockaway (2021/2022) and Oakwood Beach are not CSS. Appellate Division (June 2026) held DEP's notices fell short of SPRTK; city seeking Court of Appeals review. Hunts Point WRRF outfalls discharge to Western Long Island Sound/Eastchester Bay/Hutchinson River (shared water with CT).
